name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled sites, including virtual hosts, static content, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall and SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and final configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application with Python tooling, a Git checkout and virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user configuration, application secrets, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
